pages.ko: "천천히, 앞을 봐요!" 공원에 온 호리가 손을 흔들며 외쳐요. 오늘은 토토가 새 킥보드를 가져온 날이에요. 토토는 신이 나서 발을 쿵쿵— "나 이거 엄청 빨라! 봐 봐!"
pages.t: "Slow down, look ahead!" Hori waved and called out as he arrived at the park. Today Toto brought his brand-new scooter. Toto was so excited, stomping his feet. "I'm super fast on this! Watch me!"

pages.ko: 토토는 발로 바닥을 쿵쿵 차며 씽— 하고 쏜살같이 달려나갔어요. "빠를수록 재밌어! 더 빨리, 더 빨리!" 호리가 뒤에서 소리쳐요. "토토야, 헬멧! 헬멧 쓰고 가!" 하지만 토토는 벌써 저만치 멀어졌어요.
pages.t: Toto pushed off the ground and zoomed away like a shot. "The faster, the more fun! Faster, faster!" Hori called out from behind. "Toto, your helmet! Put your helmet on!" But Toto was already far away.

pages.ko: 그때 산책로 앞에 작은 돌멩이가 툭! 토토는 앞을 안 보고 달리다 킥보드가 휘청— 기우뚱! 토토는 두 발을 얼른 바닥에 딛고 겨우 멈췄어요. "어어— 앗!" 가슴이 콩닥콩닥, 넘어질 뻔했어요.
pages.t: Suddenly, a small rock appeared on the path! Toto wasn't watching ahead, and his scooter wobbled and tilted. He quickly planted both feet on the ground and barely managed to stop. "Whoa— ah!" His heart was pounding, and he nearly fell.

pages.ko: 호리가 헬멧을 들고 헐레벌떡 달려왔어요. "토토야, 괜찮아? 너무 빨리 달리면 앞이 잘 안 보여." 토토는 고개를 끄덕끄덕. "돌멩이를 아예 못 봤어…" 호리가 토토 손을 잡아 주었어요. "우리 안전하게 타는 약속 배워 볼까?"
pages.t: Hori ran over out of breath, carrying the helmet. "Toto, are you okay? If you go too fast, it's hard to see what's ahead." Toto nodded. "I didn't see the rock at all…" Hori took Toto's hand. "Want to learn how to ride safely together?"

pages.ko: 호리가 파란 헬멧을 토토 머리에 톡 씌워 주었어요. "가장 먼저, 헬멧을 딱! 머리를 지켜 주는 든든한 모자야." 딸깍, 턱끈까지 야무지게. 토토는 머리를 살살 만지며 씩 웃었어요. "오, 든든한데?"
pages.t: Hori placed a blue helmet snugly on Toto's head. "First of all, always wear your helmet! It's a strong hat that protects your head." Click — he fastened the chin strap securely too. Toto touched his head and grinned. "Oh, this feels really safe!"

pages.ko: 호리가 세 가지 약속을 알려 줬어요. "하나, 탈 땐 꼭 헬멧을 써요! 둘, 너무 빨리 말고 천천히! 셋, 앞을 잘 보고, 위험하면 발로 콕 멈춰요!" 토토는 두 주먹을 불끈 쥐었어요. "나도 할 수 있어! 천천히, 앞을 봐요!"
pages.t: Hori shared three promises. "One, always wear your helmet when you ride! Two, go slowly, not too fast! Three, look ahead carefully, and if it's dangerous, stop with your foot!" Toto clenched his fists tight. "I can do it too! Slow down, look ahead!"

pages.ko: 이번엔 토토가 헬멧을 쓰고, 천천히 또르르 달렸어요. 앞을 잘 보며 슬금슬금— 저 앞에 강아지 두부가 지나가자 토토는 발을 콕 딛어 멈췄어요. "천천히, 앞을 봐요!" 두부가 지나갈 때까지 기다렸다가 다시 살살 출발!
pages.t: This time, Toto wore his helmet and rode slowly and steadily. Watching ahead carefully, he rolled along little by little — when the puppy Dubu crossed in front of him, Toto planted his foot and stopped. "Slow down, look ahead!" He waited until Dubu passed, then gently started off again.

pages.ko: 토토는 어깨가 으쓱, 마음이 뿌듯해요. "천천히 타니까 하나도 안 넘어져! 앞도 다 보여!" 신이 난 토토를 보며 호리도 활짝 웃었어요. 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 둘은 손뼉을 짝짝 마주쳤어요.
pages.t: Toto's shoulders puffed up with pride. "Riding slowly means I don't fall at all! And I can see everything ahead!" Seeing Toto so happy, Hori smiled brightly too. At that moment, Hori's tail stripes sparkled in rainbow colors — vroom! The two of them clapped their hands together.

pages.ko: 이제 토토는 킥보드를 탈 때마다 세 약속을 스스로 지켜요. 하나, 헬멧을 딱! 둘, 천천히 또르르! 셋, 앞을 잘 보고, 위험하면 발로 콕 멈춰요! 다음에 놀러 온 날, 토토가 먼저 헬멧을 챙기며 외쳤어요. 천천히, 앞을 봐요!
pages.t: Now, every time Toto rides his scooter, he keeps the three promises all by himself. One, wear your helmet! Two, go slowly! Three, look ahead carefully, and stop with your foot if it's dangerous! The next time he came out to play, Toto grabbed his helmet first and called out. Slow down, look ahead!

pages.ko: 놀이가 끝나고 호리가 토토를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "우리 토토, 천천히 안전하게 타서 정말 멋졌어!" 이제 토토는 알아요. 빠른 것보다 안전한 게 훨씬 재밌다는 걸. 천천히, 앞을 봐요!
pages.t: When playtime was over, Hori gave Toto a big hug. "Our Toto, riding slowly and safely was so wonderful!" Now Toto knows. Being safe is so much more fun than being fast. Slow down, look ahead!
